title: Band-9 Samples: When was the last time you went to an art gallery or exhibition? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 12 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 4 question: “When was the last time you went to an art gallery or exhibition? [Why?]” Sample 1: Not Long Ago Female Male Somewhat recently, a group of my friends and I decided to visit an art exhibition. It was more of a social outing than a cultural exploration though. The highlight was not just the artwork but also the lively discussions we had about the different pieces. It was a vibrant and engaging experience that strengthened our bonds and expanded our perspectives. Sample 2: Not Long Ago Female Male A couple of weeks ago, I found myself wandering through the halls of an art gallery, not out of leisure, but due to an assignment for my art history class. The visit was intended to enhance my understanding of various art movements. Observing the artworks in person, instead of through a textbook, made the learning process incredibly enriching. Sample 3: Not Long Ago Female Male Not too long ago, I spent a quiet afternoon in an art gallery as a form of relaxation. Amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, I find the serene ambiance of galleries to be quite soothing. The opportunity to step back, to appreciate the beauty and subtlety of art, offers me a form of escapism that I find deeply restorative. Sample 4: Not Long Ago Female Male Just a fortnight ago, I found myself wandering the halls of the local art exhibition. You see, I’m an amateur artist, and I was feeling somewhat uninspired, a little lost in my creative journey. The exhibition was a treasure trove of inspiration, a visual feast that stirred my stagnant imagination. The vibrant colors, the diverse styles, and the powerful narratives breathed new life into my artistry. Sample 5: A Long Time Ago Female Male I recall the last time I visited an art gallery was quite a long time ago, during the early stages of my relationship with my partner. We were still getting to know each other, and she, being an art lover, suggested exploring an art exhibition in town. Although I was initially reluctant, the experience turned out to be incredibly captivating. The art pieces sparked fascinating conversations and helped deepen our bond. Sample 6: A Long Time Ago Female Male Believe it or not, it’s been nearly a decade since I last visited an art gallery, back in my late twenties. At that time, I was going through a difficult phase and found solace in solitude. I would often visit the gallery, immersing myself in the silent conversations between the art and its viewers. Each visit was like a therapeutic session, providing me with a sense of calm and helping me navigate through my emotional turmoil. Sample 7: A Long Time Ago Female Male The last time I visited an art gallery was a lifetime ago, during my childhood. I was about ten years old, and my aunt took me along for one of her frequent gallery visits. The colorful paintings and intricate sculptures fascinated my young mind and sparked an enduring interest in art. Sample 8: A Long Time Ago Female Male The last time I found myself wandering in an art gallery was a good number of years back, during my vacation in Japan. I was intrigued by the country’s rich heritage and unique aesthetics, and I thought an art exhibition would be an excellent avenue to delve deeper into their cultural nuances. Sample 9: Never Female Male Honestly, I’ve never set foot in an art gallery or exhibition. Living in a rural area, I’ve had limited access to such cultural experiences. Our local community emphasizes practical skills over fine arts, so my exposure to art has been through the school curriculum and not through formal galleries or exhibitions. Sample 10: Never Female Male Frankly, I’ve never attended an art gallery or exhibition. The primary reason is a lack of interest in traditional forms of art. While I appreciate the skills and creativity involved, the static nature of such exhibits doesn’t captivate me. I find myself more engrossed in dynamic, interactive experiences like live performances or sporting events.
